title: Chore Contract Breach Count
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ourhome:chore chore_status="overdue"
| stats count as overdue_chores, values(chore_name) as chores by child_name
| sort - overdue_chores
description: Tracks how often the current household chore contract is being missed or left overdue.
value: The point of a contract is consistency, and this metric surfaces where expectations need adjustment or reinforcement.
implementation: Export chore state changes from OurHome and review overdue counts in the same cadence as allowance or privileges.
visualization: Table of children with overdue chore count and example chores.
grandmaExplanation: It spots where the chore agreement is slipping and needs a reset conversation.
